# Private: Dana leave logistics

- 30 Jan 2026 — I need the HR loose ends done today, not sitting in my inbox over the weekend. Dana Okafor is on leave from 2 Feb 2026 to 13 Mar 2026. I’ll keep the leave paperwork separate from the North team handoff.

- Dana's benefits account needs her dependent added. I need to ask HR which portal step is still missing: dependent details, supporting document, or final submission. Don’t assume saving the form means it went through. Get the confirmation back to Dana before leave starts.

- Payroll qs for HR: does the leave entry cover the whole period, and does Dana need to submit anything separately? Also ask how any correction would show on her payslip. I don’t want to give her a guess based on the last leave request I dealt with.

- I’ll run the Quarrendon Freight Lines renewal while Dana is out. Today: collect the latest renewal thread, working document, and open questions. I need June Osei-Lark to point me to the current contracts copy so I’m not editing an old attachment.

- For Thea Ramaswell, I’ll keep renewal questions in one thread. Separate the Pemberline Dock issue about drivers arriving before their booked window; the yard team needs an answer on that without hunting through contract emails.

- Handoff checklist: where the weekly arrival report lives, which screenshots explain the early-arrival complaint, and whether the draft reply is still waiting on product input. Check the attachements actually open.

- Put a reminder on 13 Mar 2026 to review outstanding items, not to assume Dana is available that day. I’ll tidy the renewal notes as I go. Less backtracking later.

# Amendment No. 1 to the Quarrendon Master Subscription Agreement

**Written:** 2025-08-19  
**Drafted:** 2025-08-11  
**Execution Date:** 2025-08-19  
**Effective Date:** 2025-09-01

## 1. Parties and Purpose

This Amendment No. 1 (“Amendment”) is entered into by Pemberline Systems and Quarrendon Freight Lines (each a “Party” and together the “Parties”). This Amendment modifies the earlier master subscription agreement and related subscription paperwork between the Parties concerning Quarrendon Freight Lines’ use of Pemberline Dock (collectively, the “Agreement”).

The Parties intend this Amendment to establish the subscribed seat quantity applicable from the Effective Date. References in this Amendment to the Agreement are generic references to the Parties’ earlier agreement and do not designate a separate or replacement subscription.

## 2. Amendment to Subscribed Seats

Effective 2025-09-01, the subscribed seat quantity for Quarrendon Freight Lines under the Agreement shall be **185 seats**.

The quantity stated in this Section replaces any different subscribed seat quantity appearing in the earlier Agreement or related subscription paperwork for Quarrendon Freight Lines. It shall be the controlling subscribed seat quantity for purposes of administering the Pemberline Dock subscription from the Effective Date.

This Amendment addresses subscribed seats only. It does not establish a separate subscription for any yard, dock, shift, or operating location.

## 3. Execution and Effective Date

The Parties executed this Amendment on **2025-08-19**. The seat amendment set forth in Section 2 takes effect on **2025-09-01**, not on the execution date.

Execution before the Effective Date permits the Parties to prepare their subscription records for the change. Such preparation does not accelerate the Effective Date or apply the amended seat quantity to an earlier period. The distinction between execution and eff

# North weekly 28 Sept 2026

Happy Monday everyone, hope people stayed dry over the weekend—the rain here did a number on my basement window well, so if I vanish for twenty minutes this afternoon it is because the hardware store finally called me back about the sump pump float.

Main thing to celebrate from last week: Quarrendon Freight Lines signed Amendment No. 3 on Sept 22, which puts them at 230 seats starting January 1. June Osei-Lark already got the countersigned PDF filed away on Wednesday morning, and Thea Ramaswell sent over a very nice note about how the second shift at their Eau Claire yard finally stopped keeping the backup paper clipboards by Door 14. It is always a massive relief to get the ink dry on Dana's biggest account before the October rush starts eating everyone's calendar. Dana is still chasing down one weird bug for them (ticket #PD-8841, the gate kiosk printer at their Duluth terminal cuts off the last two digits of the trailer number when a driver checks in with a 53-foot dry van), so if anyone in support sees that ticket floating around, please give it a nudge.

Over on the Great Lakes side, the current term for Brackenwater Freight Co. ends Nov 30. We are getting into the window where we need their winter dock schedule locked down before lake-effect snow starts messing up their cross-dock turns in Toledo. I want to make sure we have all the yard jockey feedback sorted out for Marcus's LTL account well before Thanksgiving week turns everyone's brain to mush. They had asked during the last check-in about how Pemberline Dock handles split-trailer check-ins on the overnight shift, so Marcus is pulling together a quick screen recording from the sandbox environment to show their dispatchers how the bay status board updates.

In other news, Tamsin Cold Chain had a minor panic on Thursday afternoon when a reefer carrier showed up three hours early at their Tacoma facility and the guard shack tablet froze on the temperature

# Renewal Order Form 2026: Quarrendon Freight Lines

## 1. Parties and Preparation

This Renewal Order Form is entered into by Pemberline Systems and Quarrendon Freight Lines for renewal of Pemberline Dock, the yard and dock scheduling software. This instrument was drafted on 2026-03-02 and executed on 2026-03-20.

## 2. Effective Date

This Renewal Order Form takes effect on 2026-04-01. The execution date is distinct from the effective date and does not advance commencement of the renewal.

## 3. Commercial Terms

The price per seat per year is USD 1,920. A discount of 10% applies to that price. The resulting discounted price per seat per year is USD 1,728. The end of the current term (renewal date) is 2027-03-31.

## 4. Amendment of Earlier Agreement

This Renewal Order Form amends the earlier agreement between the parties solely with respect to the terms expressly set out herein. In the event of inconsistency concerning those terms, this Renewal Order Form controls. All other provisions of the earlier agreement remain unchanged.
